claims.summary: NIKL particle 에 sense 14 lists 에 의하여(의한) among expressions for the topic/subject being discussed.
Kim (2012) reports that passive expressions using -에 의하여 as agent stand out in the English-to-Korean translated corpus examined compared with non-translated texts.
The research finding is limited to a specific translation corpus and does not support broad claims across genres or all Spanish translations.
